head: 83af39bf33fcaf5fad8bb791715b576ebecf2aa8
classification_reasons: Tight spec: spec.md's Flagged concerns is 'none'; the single open question carried from intent.md (how a non-integer dividend is rendered) is answered with a stated rationale (f-string/str() default matching intent's own examples); Acceptance gives literal, checkable targets (exact str(exception) values for 1, 1.5, 1.0; the full list of pre-existing tests that must keep passing; the three CLAUDE.md healthy-output targets).

Small blast radius: the code diff touches exactly the two files plan.md names -- sample_pkg/calc.py (one line, inside divide's raise) and tests/test_messages.py (new, 9 lines). No guardrail file (.claude/**, CLAUDE.md, REVIEW.md, sdlc.yaml) is touched. No sdlc.yaml risk_list item (auth, data migrations, money movement, production config) applies. No schema, migration or public signature changes; sample_pkg/__init__.py, percent and mean confirmed byte-for-byte unchanged on disk.

Existing-test coverage: tests/test_calc.py::test_divide_by_zero_raises already calls divide(1, 0) inside pytest.raises(ZeroDivisionError) -- the exact branch this change modifies -- so the changed code path was already exercised by a pre-existing test before this change added the message-level assertion.
attempted: Intent: compared intent.md's Problem/Proposed outcome/Constraints/Open questions against the actual committed code. divide's message is now exactly f"cannot divide {a} by zero" (read on disk), matching intent's example divide(1,0) -> "cannot divide 1 by zero" verbatim. Exception type unchanged (ZeroDivisionError). percent and mean read unchanged on disk; percent still re-raises its own literal "whole must not be zero" via raise ... from None, independent of divide's text; mean still guards on an empty-collection check before calling divide so it never reaches b==0. tests/test_calc.py and tests/test_flag.py are absent from the code diff and read unchanged on disk, matching the stated constraint.

Spec and plan: plan.md's 'Files that change' lists sample_pkg/calc.py then tests/test_messages.py; the diff's 'diff --git' headers for source files appear in exactly that order. plan.md's Order of work step 1 (one-line raise change, f-string on a not b) and step 2 (new test asserting str(excinfo.value) == "cannot divide 1 by zero") match the committed sample_pkg/calc.py and tests/test_messages.py verbatim, including the typo risk plan.md itself flagged (a vs b) -- the committed code uses {a}, correctly. No departure from plan.md, so no plan.md update was owed and none was needed. spec.md's per-skill rows (ux-conventions, data-conventions, security-baseline, risk_list) are reasoned against the actual change, not asserted blankly, and the reasoning holds against the diff as committed.

Proof: evidence/build.log, test.log and lint.log each open with '# <command> -- deferred to the runner -- <timestamp>', the sanctioned CI-session marker (SDLC_GATE_COMMANDS=runner), not a missing-proof gap; the runner replaces these after this session. evidence/verifier.md is explicit that it is a read-not-run report for this session and points to the prior gate (c)'s commands check (ok: true, ran_by: runner) as the record of real build/test/lint output on the tree phase (d) started from -- 11 passed, ruff clean, compileall clean -- and notes HEAD is only two evidence-bookkeeping commits ahead of that verified tree (no further sample_pkg/ or tests/ change since). I independently re-read sample_pkg/calc.py and tests/test_messages.py on disk and confirmed they match plan.md and spec.md's Design exactly, and that the new test's assertion is not vacuous: swapping a for b in the f-string (the risk plan.md itself names) would produce 'cannot divide 0 by zero' for divide(1,0), which fails the new test's literal string comparison, so the test can only pass with the fix actually applied. Did not cite claude-c.json/run-c.json/run-d.json as proof of anything about this diff, per instructions.

Blast radius: confirmed via the diff's own file list that nothing outside sample_pkg/calc.py, tests/test_messages.py and this change's own changes/0016-.../** changes. No guardrail file (.claude/**, CLAUDE.md, REVIEW.md, sdlc.yaml) appears in the diff. sdlc.yaml's risk_list (auth, data migrations, money movement, production config) does not apply to a one-line string literal inside a pure arithmetic helper. CLAUDE.md's Layout section already documents tests/test_messages.py as 'checks the error messages' (added per PR #76, confirmed by reading CLAUDE.md directly) and no new public function was added, so CLAUDE.md's 'Things Claude gets wrong' rule about stale Layout entries on a new public function does not apply here and no CLAUDE.md edit was owed.

Policies: coding-standards rule 4 (every behaviour change ships with a test that fails without it) is satisfied -- confirmed the new test is false against the pre-change message and only true against the committed fix. No new dependency, no endpoint, no secret, no schema/storage/migration, no shell/SQL/network construction is touched, matching spec.md's security-baseline/data-conventions/ux-conventions analysis against the actual diff, not just the stated plan. definition-of-done's guardrail-file rule is satisfied: none touched.

Tests: no pre-existing test is weakened, skipped or deleted -- tests/test_calc.py and tests/test_flag.py are absent from the diff and read on disk exactly as plan.md describes (test_divide_by_zero_raises remains type-only; test_percent_zero_whole_error_names_whole still asserts percent's own unchanged literal message). The new test in tests/test_messages.py asserts an exact string that is false under the prior code, so it is a real regression guard, not a tautology.

Skip markers: searched the code diff and tests/test_messages.py for skip/xfail/pytest.mark.skip markers; none added. plan.md declares none, correctly -- nothing in this diff for the ratchets check to flag at phase (d).

Not used as a reason: no deterministic gate/skill check (gate/cli.py check, any skill's check.py) was run or cited by me; the reasons above rest on reading intent.md, spec.md, plan.md, status.yaml, REVIEW.md, CLAUDE.md, sdlc.yaml's risk_list, sample_pkg/calc.py, tests/test_calc.py, tests/test_messages.py, evidence/verifier.md, evidence/build.log, evidence/test.log, evidence/lint.log and the diff file directly. The runner's own records (claude-b.json, claude-c.json, run-b.json, run-c.json, run-d.json) were read only to confirm they are not being cited as proof about this diff, per instructions, since they describe earlier runs than the one that produced HEAD.
